statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks and six representative paths. No local source was supplied; report mode only.

page.framework: Legacy server-rendered MPA with a frameset area hub, jQuery-style widgets, and a delegated zauth.net login.
page.notes: Audited home, Tokyo area hub, entertainment listing, representative thread, login, and unknown-route recovery. Other regions/categories were not repeated because they share the same templates; authenticated account settings, destructive posting, and commercial flows were not exercised without credentials.

Tokyo area hub; represents the legacy frameset and regional content index.
Entertainment thread listing; represents dense category/listing templates.
Representative public thread/detail and posting surface; used for performance, privacy, accessibility, metadata, and memory interaction tests.

findings.summary: The public forum is light-only.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains a white surface, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme, light-dark(), or color-scheme implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark tokens using the dark-mode guidance.

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe still found a running 6.5-second animation and no reduced-motion media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential repeating motion within prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: The interface has no high-contrast adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule; the high-contrast capture retains the same dense, low-emphasis styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast treatments that preserve control boundaries and focus.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across MPA navigation or the stamp modal state change.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same- and cross-document changes with View Transitions and reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state guidance.
findings.evidence: The listing and thread are several screens long, but screenshots and CSS inspection show no progress indicator or scroll-reactive chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll-progress/position affordance for long lists and threads.

findings.summary: Transient UI is manually positioned rather than anchored.
findings.evidence: The stamp overlay is custom DOM, while the CSS probe found no anchor positioning, popover, or dialog primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/dialog and CSS anchor positioning where a transient control must stay attached to its trigger.

findings.summary: The stamp overlay is an ad-hoc control.
findings.evidence: The thread exposes custom .js-stampmodal-open/.close controls, while the probe found zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the custom overlay with dialog or popover and declarative light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Advertising and chrome overwhelm the content.
findings.evidence: At 360px the desktop page is scaled to fit; the listing is dominated by banners, a dense image grid and side rail, while the thread places multiple ads before and beside the core discussion.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce above-the-fold promotional units, defer secondary rails, and preserve a clear content column.

findings.summary: Core forum templates render as shrunken desktop pages on mobile.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, listing/thread layout metrics report innerWidth 1100 and a scale of about 0.327; screenshots show tiny desktop text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width,initial-scale=1 and fluid intrinsic layouts rather than a fixed 1100px canvas.

findings.summary: Dense components do not adapt to their available width.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries; the listing grid and side rail are merely scaled down at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Refactor cards, rails, and post controls with container queries and intrinsic grid sizing.

findings.summary: Forum controls are too small and keyboard focus is not visible.
findings.evidence: Focused forum links report outline: none; many navigation targets are only 25px high, and Lighthouse fails target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide :focus-visible styles, at least 44px touch targets, and non-hover equivalents.

findings.summary: The next useful action is buried in competing content.
findings.evidence: The mobile listing first viewport contains dense navigation, banners, tabs, a search strip, a large image grid and a side rail before a clear thread-reading action.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the listing title, search/filter, and primary thread links; defer secondary modules.

findings.summary: The error state is cryptic and lacks a direct recovery action.
findings.evidence: The unknown-route page says “ika error! click” and instructs users to use the browser Back button rather than offering a clear home/search/retry action.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a plain-language Japanese error heading and direct Home, Search, and Back links.

findings.summary: The representative thread is slow and unstable.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse reports LCP 4.2s, TBT 990ms, CLS 0.12, and performance 0.45.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, cut blocking third-party work, and reserve late content space.

findings.summary: Late assets shift the page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports CLS 0.12 and the image audit finds 90 of 100 images without both dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for images and reserve ad/widget slots.

findings.summary: Third-party scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: The trace records a 541.82ms long task and 503.94ms TBT; Lighthouse records 990ms TBT and a 22.5s time to interactive.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or defer non-essential scripts and split remaining work into sub-50ms tasks.

findings.summary: The thread has an excessive dependency and transfer footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR records 249 requests and 2,357,529 transferred bytes, including 55 scripts and 153 images; Lighthouse flags cache, font, HTTP, dependency-tree and render-blocking insights.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, cache immutable assets, preload only true critical resources, and defer ads/widgets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags unused CSS, unused JavaScript, unminified CSS/JS, legacy JavaScript and heavy main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to remove unused bundles and load optional features only on interaction.

findings.summary: Accessible names and semantics are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility is 0.56 and fails image-alt, label, link-name, select-name, list/listitem, definition-list and frame-title; the runtime probe finds several untitled third-party iframes and 21 empty-name links.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix native semantics, labels, alternative text, frame titles and accessible names before adding ARIA.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG checks.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails the color-contrast audit on the thread, and the site has no contrast-preference adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in all states.

findings.summary: Heading structure and focus treatment are unreliable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails heading-order and tabindex; direct focus probes show outline: none on forum links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a logical heading/landmark hierarchy and consistent :focus-visible rings in reading order.

findings.summary: The core forum is unreadably small on mobile.
findings.evidence: The 1100px desktop layout is scaled to roughly 32.7% at 360px, producing tiny body and control text in the listing and thread captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow to a true mobile content column with fluid type and comfortable line length.

findings.summary: Reflow and target sizing fail on the core templates.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport and target-size, while the 360px captures preserve a desktop canvas rather than reflowing.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow normal user scaling and reflow; enlarge interactive targets and avoid fixed-width layout assumptions.

findings.summary: Asset markup is unsized and inefficient.
findings.evidence: The image audit finds 90 missing dimensions, 43 oversized assets and 82 legacy-format images; Lighthouse fails unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, correct aspect ratios and modern responsive image sources.

findings.summary: The page triggers platform hygiene diagnostics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags deprecations, inspector issues, BFCache blockers, third-party cookies, and missing source-map quality.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools deprecations/inspector issues, remove BFCache blockers, and publish valid source maps for owned production bundles.

findings.summary: Mobile and link crawlability signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport and crawlable-anchors; the runtime probe reports 7 anchors without href and 21 linked elements with no discernible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a responsive viewport and real descriptive anchors for navigational actions.

findings.summary: The article template lacks structured data and has malformed social description content.
findings.evidence: The thread exposes zero JSON-LD blocks; og:description contains HTML-like “<div><imgsrc=...>” text rather than a clean summary.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate DiscussionForumPosting/Article JSON-LD and plain-text Open Graph/Twitter descriptions.

findings.summary: Secure transport is undermined by missing defenses and insecure cookies.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP and HSTS are absent; all 13 observed first-party cookies lack Secure, including bakusai_session.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies, deploy HSTS and a nonce/hash-based CSP, and add nosniff.

findings.summary: The thread has an extensive tracking footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe sees 30 third-party origins and known Google Analytics, DoubleClick and Rubicon trackers; HAR records 249 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit necessity, obtain meaningful consent where required, remove redundant trackers, and batch/defer analytics.

findings.summary: Authentication does not offer a phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the delegated login probe finds password/OAuth options and no WebAuthn/passkey implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-safe existing methods.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers are missing clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP and HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, strict Referrer-Policy, scoped Permissions-Policy and HSTS.

findings.summary: Unknown-route recovery is not actionable.
findings.evidence: The exercised 404 route renders “ika error! click” and relies on the browser back button instead of direct recovery choices.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an intentional 404 with plain language and direct Home, Search and retry paths.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and decoding work.
findings.evidence: Of 100 listing images, 82 use legacy formats, 43 are oversized, 40 lack srcset and 70 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive sources, size to display, and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: Background and third-party work is disproportionate.
findings.evidence: The thread loads 249 requests from 33 origins and later executes a 541.82ms long task, despite a simple text/article-and-comments core task.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer background fetches and ad/analytics processing until idle, visible, or explicitly needed.

findings.summary: Third-party and media weight exceeds the value of the text thread.
findings.evidence: HAR transfers 2.36MB, with 1.17MB of images and 882KB of scripts; 30 third-party origins participate.
findings.suggestedFix: Set budgets for third-party requests/bytes and remove or delay units that do not support the current task.

findings.summary: Forum capabilities are not exposed as structured agent tools.
findings.evidence: The public content is crawler-visible (89% raw/rendered overlap), but no WebMCP/agentic tool surface was found despite a visible “生成AI企業パートナー募集” link on the error template.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider safe read/search/report tools with explicit schemas and confirmation for posting actions.

findings.summary: Repeated stamp-modal use retains a large amount of JavaScript state.
findings.evidence: After 10 open/close cycles, heap nodes rise from 508,125 to 733,629 and self size from 29.22MB to 36.05MB; m.fn.init objects rise from 134 to 20,954 and closures from 24,540 to 64,725. Same-session used heap rises about 4.18MB while DOM elements stay at 3,076.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the stamp-modal event path, bind handlers once, remove listeners on close, and release jQuery/object references.

findings.summary: The baseline client footprint is heavy for a text thread.
findings.evidence: A fresh loaded thread heap contains 508,125 snapshot nodes and 29.22MB self size alongside 249 network requests and 55 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party scripts and lazy-initialise optional widgets to lower baseline heap and code populations.

findings.summary: The modal interaction appears to accumulate handlers or retained wrappers.
findings.evidence: Across 10 open/close cycles the live DOM count stays 3,076, yet closures add 40,185 and m.fn.init wrappers add 20,820, consistent with retained listeners/wrappers rather than visible DOM growth.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit addEventListener/jQuery .on calls, use stable handler references, and unregister or abort listeners when the modal closes.

taskList.title: Rebuild core forum templates as genuine responsive layouts
Reduce and defer advertising, third-party scripts, and unused code
Deploy secure cookie and browser header policies
Fix semantic structure, names, contrast, labels, focus, and target size
Optimise and intrinsically size image delivery
Add preference-driven dark, reduced-motion, and contrast treatments
Simplify content hierarchy and error recovery
